source: FIGURES.md adapted for clubs, 2026-09-24, as for the Tokyo, Budapest, NYC, Amsterdam, Ibiza and Paris guides. Live Google SERP for 'best clubs in prague' (US, 2026-09-24) read in full: Reddit r/Prague, thepartyingtraveler, Tripadvisor Attractions list, bestclubsprague.com, pragueexperience.com, praguego.com. History and dates: Wikipedia (Cross Club, Businesses); Atlas Obscura and Radio Prague International (Cross Club's founding and crowdfunding); karlovylazne.cz and prague.org (Karlovy Lázně); DJ Mag Top 100 Clubs (Duplex, 2022 and 2025); Mixmag and DJ Mag (Ankali's 2025 closure risk); Resident Advisor and Boiler Room (Boiler Room Prague, December 2018). Dress code, checked in the editorial review pass on 2026-09-24: livingprague.com (Duplex turns away sportswear), oh-my-prague.com and perfectitinerary.io (Cross Club and Ankali have none); Karlovy Lázně is reported both ways (nightflow.com says casual/no sportswear, its own site says none), so the FAQ states the conflict rather than picking a side. The Cross Club image and one factual claim differ deliberately from best-clubbing-cities-in-europe.html, which already covers Cross Club in one paragraph with its own exterior courtyard photograph (owner's decision, 2026-09-24: write a dedicated, deeper Prague page rather than fold it into the hub or skip it).
